name: DataFast revenue analytics landing page by datafa.st
description: A long, conversion-focused analytics landing page uses a warm off-white canvas, near-black typography, and a restrained coral-orange accent for every primary action. The hero is sparse and centered, then the page becomes progressively denser through dashboard imagery, testimonial feeds, three-step cards, feature tiles, integrations, pricing, FAQ, and a final CTA/footer; repeated framed screenshots and soft shadows create continuity across the changing rhythms.
